Overview

Cyber & Zero-Trust for Automotive & Discrete Manufacturing earns its budget only when it changes a number on someone's scorecard. So we invert the usual sequence: lock the metric and its baseline first, then work backwards to the smallest architecture that moves it — usually composed from MES layers and the tower platform rather than built from scratch. The Manufacturing & Industrial operating reality gives this work its shape: OEE uplift pressure at event speed, ISO 9001 / IATF 16949 quality obligations on every artifact, and practitioners who will not accept recommendations they cannot interrogate. The pattern below is calibrated to those three forces.
